note: Governance deadlines with defaults live here, not only in prose. scripts/check_deadlines.py runs daily (xsec-deadlines.timer): reminders before the due time, and after it an unmet condition records the default and sends one Telegram notice. Applying a default that changes live behaviour stays a human/agent action recorded in DECISIONS.md and the journal.
